title: KbNote
description: One entry in kb/lab-notes/observations.jsonl — a provenance-tagged, mutable lab observation. Canonical promotion (to kb/canonical/) requires real-runtime evidence + conflict check (plan §9).

source.description: Evidence provenance. 'trace' = real-runtime capture; others are hypotheses until confirmed by trace.

mechanic.description: Mechanic identifier or 'global' for cross-cutting observations

lane.description: Which mapper lane this observation applies to

evidence_refs.description: Relative paths to supporting artifacts (captures, run dirs, findings files)

promoted.description: True if this note has been promoted to kb/canonical/ (requires real-runtime evidence)
